newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Thousands abandon Zaire refugee camps - witnesses.
newsitem.headline: Thousands abandon Zaire refugee camps - witnesses.

text.p: Thousands of Hutu refugees have abandoned sprawling camps in eastern Zaire and are on the road towards Rwanda, witnesses reported on Friday.

"The impasse has been broken. People are moving in the right direction... There could be up to the total population of the camps moving towards Rwanda," Ray Wilkinson of the U.N. refugee agency told Reuters at Mugunga camp.
"We've got at least 250,000 on the move and there are another 500,000 out there," Stefano Severe of the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees told Reuters.
Aid officials confirmed the vanguard of the human tide had crossed into Rwanda.
